title: Transactions
description: Most of them sort themselves (Pluggy category, merchant dictionary and your rules). What is left, you teach once.

export.tooLarge: Too many transactions for a single file. Choose a shorter period.
export.rateLimited: Too many downloads in a row. Wait a moment and try again.
export.failed: Could not download the spreadsheet. Try again.

banner.uncategorizedDetail: Usually Pix to a person. Pick the category and tick “always” to create a rule.
banner.allDoneDetail: The next matching transactions will land in the right category.

empty.filteredDescription: Try another month or remove a filter.
empty.monthDescription: Pick another month to see the transactions.

inline.invalidRule: This transaction has no payee identified; the rule will use the description
inline.kindMismatchOut: An income category does not fit an outflow
inline.kindMismatchIn: An expense category does not fit an inflow

toast.reverted: The category went back to automatic
toast.ruleCreatedWithCount_one: Rule created for {{target}}: {{count}} more transaction recategorized.
toast.ruleCreatedWithCount_other: Rule created for {{target}}: {{count}} more transactions recategorized.
